exclude: Most experiments unless they demonstrate an important theoretical principle
principles: Broaden beyond topics closely related to my own publications
Rank by conceptual interest and personal relevance
Explain unfamiliar concepts with brief background and motivation

selection.additional_papers: Include additional papers only when they are important, interesting, and clearly fit my interests; do not pad the selection

format: Clean numerical ranking and daily overview; summary, background, and why it matters for each of 10–20 papers, without priority verdicts
